description: Vet a local MCP server directory, SKILL.md skill directory, or client config tree before install. Inventories declared and actual tools, flags dangerous capability combinations, audits autostart configs and bundled scripts, checks declared vs actual mismatches, version pinning, and typosquat distance. Static only: scanned code is never executed. Returns a VETTED, REVIEW, or DO-NOT-INSTALL verdict with evidence per finding.

path.description: Local directory to vet: an MCP server dir, a skill dir with SKILL.md, or a tree containing client MCP configs

name: vet_path
